about: Config for the publish gate (.githooks/publish_gate.py). Every top-level directory that contains an HTML file is treated as a CLIENT NAMESPACE and gets the universal checks, unless it is listed in exclude. Add public or scratch directories to exclude; add a client-specific convention check under namespaces. Field names are camelCase on purpose.

exampleclient.about: Closed engagement, kept as the worked example of an opt-in convention check. Every non-index page must carry the home button class.
